title: Bangiga Dhexe ee Tanzania: dammaanado 1.6 tirilyan ah ayaa ganacsatada u furay amaah 2.1 tirilyan oo shilin ah
summary: Bangiga Dhexe ee Tanzania (BoT) ayaa sheegay inuu bixiyay dammaanado amaah oo dhan 1.6 tirilyan oo shilin, kuwaas oo ganacsatada u fududeeyay amaah dhan 2.1 tirilyan oo shilin oo qaybo kala duwan oo dhaqaalaha ah, sida ay werisay Daily News oo dowladdu leedahay.
originalTitle: BoT guarantees unlock 2.1tri/- loans for businesses
imageAlt: Xarunta Bangiga Dhexe ee Tanzania ee Dar es Salaam

en.title: Bank of Tanzania guarantees unlock 2.1 trillion shillings in loans
en.summary: The Bank of Tanzania (BoT) said it has issued credit guarantees worth 1.6 trillion shillings, helping businesses obtain loans totalling 2.1 trillion shillings across various sectors of the economy, the government-owned Daily News reported.
en.imageAlt: Headquarters of the Bank of Tanzania in Dar es Salaam

ar.title: ضمانات بنك تنزانيا تتيح قروضاً بقيمة 2.1 تريليون شلن
ar.summary: قال بنك تنزانيا المركزي إنه أصدر ضمانات ائتمانية بقيمة 1.6 تريليون شلن، ساعدت الشركات على الحصول على قروض بإجمالي 2.1 تريليون شلن في قطاعات اقتصادية مختلفة، بحسب صحيفة ديلي نيوز المملوكة للحكومة.
ar.imageAlt: مقر البنك المركزي التنزاني في دار السلام

fr.title: Les garanties de la Banque de Tanzanie débloquent 2.1 billions de shillings de prêts
fr.summary: La Banque de Tanzanie (BoT) a indiqué avoir émis des garanties de crédit de 1.6 billion de shillings, permettant aux entreprises d'obtenir des prêts totalisant 2.1 billions de shillings dans divers secteurs de l'économie, selon le Daily News, journal public.
fr.imageAlt: Le siège de la Banque de Tanzanie à Dar es Salaam

nl.title: Garanties van Bank of Tanzania maken 2.1 biljoen shilling aan leningen vrij
nl.summary: De Bank of Tanzania (BoT) zegt kredietgaranties ter waarde van 1.6 biljoen shilling te hebben verstrekt, waardoor bedrijven in diverse sectoren leningen van in totaal 2.1 biljoen shilling kregen, meldt de staatskrant Daily News.
nl.imageAlt: Het hoofdkantoor van de Bank of Tanzania in Dar es Salaam

it.title: Le garanzie della Banca della Tanzania sbloccano 2.1 trilioni di scellini di prestiti
it.summary: La Banca della Tanzania (BoT) ha detto di aver emesso garanzie sul credito per 1.6 trilioni di scellini, aiutando le imprese a ottenere prestiti per un totale di 2.1 trilioni di scellini in vari settori dell'economia, riferisce il quotidiano statale Daily News.
it.imageAlt: La sede della Banca di Tanzania a Dar es Salaam

de.title: Garantien der Bank of Tanzania ermöglichen Kredite über 2.1 Billionen Schilling
de.summary: Die Bank of Tanzania (BoT) hat nach eigenen Angaben Kreditgarantien über 1.6 Billionen Schilling vergeben, mit denen Unternehmen in verschiedenen Wirtschaftszweigen Kredite von insgesamt 2.1 Billionen Schilling erhielten, berichtet die staatliche Zeitung Daily News.
de.imageAlt: Der Sitz der Bank of Tanzania in Daressalam

tr.title: Tanzanya Merkez Bankası garantileri 2.1 trilyon şilinlik krediyi mümkün kıldı
tr.summary: Tanzanya Merkez Bankası (BoT), 1.6 trilyon şilin değerinde kredi garantisi verdiğini ve bunun işletmelerin ekonominin çeşitli sektörlerinde toplam 2.1 trilyon şilinlik kredi almasını sağladığını açıkladı, devlete ait Daily News'in haberine göre.
tr.imageAlt: Tanzanya Merkez Bankası'nın Darüsselam'daki genel merkezi

es.title: Las garantías del Banco de Tanzania desbloquean préstamos por 2.1 billones de chelines
es.summary: El Banco de Tanzania (BoT) dijo que ha emitido garantías de crédito por 1.6 billones de chelines, que han permitido a las empresas obtener préstamos por un total de 2.1 billones de chelines en distintos sectores de la economía, informó el diario estatal Daily News.
es.imageAlt: La sede del Banco de Tanzania en Dar es Salaam

body:
Bangiga Dhexe ee Tanzania (BoT) ayaa sheegay in dammaanadaha amaahda ee uu bixiyay, oo dhan 1.6 tirilyan oo shilin, ay suurtageliyeen amaah dhan 2.1 tirilyan oo shilin oo la siiyay ganacsiyo ka shaqeeya qaybo kala duwan oo dhaqaalaha ah. Sida ay werisay Daily News, oo ah wargeys ay dowladdu leedahay, xogtan waxaa la soo bandhigay 9 November 2026.

Dammaanadaha ayaa la bixiyaa iyadoo loo marayo laba barnaamij oo dowladdu taageerto oo uu maamulo bangiga dhexe: Barnaamijka Dammaanadda Amaahda Dhoofinta (ECGS), oo la aasaasay July 2002, iyo Barnaamijka Dammaanadda Amaahda Ganacsiyada Yaryar iyo Kuwa Dhexe (SMECGS), oo la bilaabay September 2005. Labaduba waxay caawiyaan ganacsiyo mashaariic macquul ah leh, gaar ahaan dhoofiyeyaasha iyo ganacsiyada yaryar, balse aan haysan dammaanad ku filan oo bangiyadu ka dalbadaan.

Falanqeeyaha maaliyadeed ee sare ee BoT, Gloria Chellunga, oo ka hadashay aqoon-is-weydaarsi loo qabtay wariyeyaasha, ayaa sheegtay in bangiyadu ay BoT u gudbiyaan codsiyada macaamiisha u qalma amaahda balse dammaanaddoodu yar tahay. Bangiga dhexe ayaa markaas hubiya in mashruucu uu dakhli ku filan soo saari karo si amaahda loo bixiyo, kaddibna wuu oggolaadaa dammaanadda.

Chellunga ayaa sheegtay in ganacsiyada yaryar, oo ah kuwa ugu badan ee barnaamijyada loogu talagalay, ay weli si yar uga qaybqaataan, taas oo ay qayb ahaan ku sababeysay tirada badan ee ganacsiyada aan diiwaangashanayn ee ku adag inay buuxiyaan shuruudaha sharciga. Daily News ma sheegin tirada ganacsiyada ka faa'iideystay iyo bangiyada ka qaybqaatay.
verification: Xaqiijin: Daily News (Tanzania, WebFetch, maqaalka oo dhan, 9 Nov 2026). Cinwaanka waa la saxay: 1.6 tirilyan waa dammaanadaha, 2.1 tirilyan waa amaahda ay furaan.
